business_summary: Novogene Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides genomic services and solutions in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers genomic solutions comprising human, animal, plant, and microbial whole genome sequencing, as well as human and mouse whole exome sequencing, microbial de novo sequencing, animal and plant de novo sequencing, and 16S/18S/ITS amplicon and shotgun metagenomic sequencing; transcriptomics solutions, such as mRNA, long non-coding RNA, small RNA, circular RNA, whole transcriptome, isoform, direct RNA, prokaryotic RNA, and meta transcriptome sequencing; and single cell gene expression, single cell long road read transcriptome, and visium formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded spatial transcriptome solutions. It also provides epigenomic solutions comprising whole genome bisulfite, reduced representation bisulfite, chromatin immunoprecipitation, and RNA immunoprecipitation sequencing; premade library and proteomics services; clinical diagnostics services, such as clinical whole exome sequencing and clinical panels; biopharma services consisting of discovery and pre-clinical, translational and clinical, and companion diagnostics; and support services. In addition, the company offers sequencing platforms under the ILLUMINA, PACBIO, 10X GENOMICS, and NANOPORE brands; and basic scientific research services in life sciences, and medical research and technical services. Its services are used in cancer research, immuno-oncology agrigenomics, environment, food science, human microbiome, plant and animal microbiome, drug discovery and development, and rare and complex diseases applications. The company serves research universities, research institutes, hospitals, pharmaceutical research and development companies, and agricultural companies. Novogene Co., Ltd. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: Novogene Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 본토, 홍콩, 마카오, 대만 및 국제적으로 게놈 서비스와 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 인간, 동물, 식물 및 미생물 전체 게놈 시퀀싱은 물론 인간 및 마우스 전체 엑솜 시퀀싱, 미생물 드 노보 시퀀싱, 동물 및 식물 드 노보 시퀀싱, 16S/18S/ITS 앰플리콘 및 샷건 메타게놈 시퀀싱으로 구성된 게놈 솔루션을 제공합니다. mRNA, 긴 비코딩 RNA, 작은 RNA, 원형 RNA, 전체 전사체, 이소형, 직접 RNA, 원핵생물 RNA 및 메타 전사체 서열분석과 같은 전사체학 솔루션; 및 단일 세포 유전자 발현, 단일 세포 긴 도로 판독 전사체 및 visium 포르말린 고정 파라핀 내장 공간 전사체 솔루션. 또한 전체 게놈 중아황산염, 감소된 표현 중아황산염, 염색질 면역침전 및 RNA 면역침전 시퀀싱을 포함하는 후성유전체 솔루션을 제공합니다. 사전 제작된 라이브러리 및 단백질체학 서비스; 임상 전체 엑솜 서열 분석 및 임상 패널과 같은 임상 진단 서비스; 발견, 전임상, 중개 및 임상, 동반진단으로 구성된 바이오제약 서비스
